Learning piano? 88 weighted keys. 61 is the minimum for two hands; 25 to 49 only for production controllers. Claude picks the Yamaha P-145, GPT the P-225. https://1billionmodels.com/musical-instruments/musical-instrument-keyboards-and-midi?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=answer

Two AI models (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT 6.1 Sol) chose with no web access; nobody tested these products. Synthetic voice. As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.
title: First digital piano: how many keys you actually need
